title: The False Stag
summary: A stag approached a sheep and asked to borrow a bushel of wheat, naming the wolf as his guarantor and bondsman....
full_text:
A stag approached a sheep and asked to borrow a bushel of wheat, naming the wolf as his guarantor and bondsman.

The prudent sheep looked at the pair and replied:

"The wolf has a habit of taking what he wants and vanishing, while you, friend Stag, have swift legs that can outrun the fastest hounds. When the day of payment arrives, where shall I run to find either of you?"
moral: Never lend to an untrustworthy borrower who has swift feet to flee when debts fall due.
